method: Sequential frozen baseline and final unmodified candidate, local HTTP TestClient, render cache cleared before each request. Three samples where n=3; others are single observations. This machine had other active jobs. These are small samples, not production percentiles or a latency SLA.

preservation.compared: All nonvisual response metadata plus exported MOL canonical isomeric SMILES and ordered atom/bond signatures. SVG geometry and MOL coordinates intentionally change.

prototype_quality.method: Twenty cases include all fourteen built-in examples. These are engine-selection experiments using the final mapped-SMILES transport, before the application integration. Quality is measured after normalization and straightening at 960x680, not the raw CoordGen search score.

limitations: Explicit alternate CoordGen remains expensive for long peptides. Its raw overlap score was 6 for both Semaglutide and Lixisenatide, becoming 0 only after normalization; no early-exit speedup is established for these cases.

The initial integrated candidate was slower because tuple(Point3D) iterated through a native IndexError per atom. Direct x/y/z access preserved identical coordinates and SVG while removing this overhead.

Host load affected wall times. The earlier candidate capture had slower default timings and a slower explicit Semaglutide seed2 than the final capture; its samples are retained here. The zero-score shortcut does not skip these long-peptide baselines. No long-peptide early-exit speedup or production latency claim is made.

earlier_candidate_capture.note: Same final layout adapter before the display-H ownership fix. No claim that the ownership change caused the difference; unrelated machine load varied.

browser_preservation.method: Actual Playwright browser. Painted glyph membership is checked against pre-fix native SVG glyphs and a separately prepared RDKit graph, including added display hydrogens. MOL downloads are parsed independently. Before-fix controls showed H labels dimmed at opacity0.12 while their bonds lit; both labels light after the fix. A standalone fixture index mismatch was corrected against its own retained red artifact before the final passing audit.
